_comment: Final-cell pixel coordinates (256 cell, facing right), measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art (packed frames, --quantize 48); airLight3 v12, airHeavy v08 and special v07 re-measured by Claude 2026-10-12 on the title-style art (round 3). Hit boxes cover the striking limb's contact end; light2 and specialForward f2 keep their auto boxes (already on the palm / the flicking hand). heavy v05 strikes with the R elbow folded across the face (no palm lift is drawn in f4); airHeavy uses the clasped hands. `_v` = the strip version a block was measured on: re-measure when it changes. `_scale` = the strip's auto head fit at that version. No gameplay damage or reach tuning.
_hands: hand: palm/fingertip point (256 cell) for shots and beams; measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art. throw f1 and specialForward f2: the R flick fingertips (Reversal: Red spawn); beamFire: the thrust palm (beam origin). beamCharge palms (no anchor: kit.js places Hollow Purple's Red and Blue at fixed offsets): far/Blue (192, 96) on f0/f2 and (172, 96) on f1, near/Red (68, 96) on f0/f2 and (78, 95) on f1.
